reviews.title: Subscription is greedy and not able to cancel….
reviews.text:
I did the free trial, from my iPad. Once the trial was about to end, I was reminded to cancel it but there’s no button at all to cancel this high subscription on their own app…

and I went to my Apple subscriptions and it’s not showing there either. So every month instead of cancelling itself out with a card decline, it keeps trying to charge me and I can’t do anything about it.

reviews.title: Update needed
reviews.text: This app hasn’t been updated in three years and Instagram posts are still set to be square. When is an upgrade coming to support current sizes? I paid for pro so I’m disappointed in this app’s ability to meet today’s standards. I used to like it back in the day.
